limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return. Use -1 for all entries. Default is 25.

group.description:
Comma-separated list of fields to group by. Controls both grouping AND which columns are shown.

Available fields:
- 'cache' - cache name (default)
- 'kind' - cache kind (Cache, SimpleCache, Static.Map, etc.)
- 'appAware' - whether cache is app-aware
- 'root' - whether cache is a ROOT (authoritative source)
- 'javaClass' - Java class of cached entries
- 'app' - app-id for cache entry (format: `<cluster>-<env>-<app>`)
- 'pkg' - package name (single word)
- 'path' - nested path (implies 'cache'). If {@link Cache.Histo.Spec#levels} is unset, depth is unbounded.

Default: 'cache' (group by cache name)

Memory semantics:
- Cache-level grouping (no javaClass/path): shows both `memorySelf` and `memoryDeep` (deep is the total, correctly apportioned).
- Element-level grouping (javaClass, path, etc.): uses `memorySelf`/`memoryDeep` (may overlap when aggregated).

Examples:
- 'cache' - default, one row per cache
- 'cache, javaClass' - expand each cache by Java class
- 'javaClass' - aggregate by Java class across all caches
- 'app, javaClass' - aggregate by app and Java class
- 'cache, kind' - show cache name and kind columns
- 'path' - same as 'cache, path' (path implies cache). If levels is unset, depth is unbounded.

order.description:
Sort order for entries (e.g., "descending(memoryDeep)", "descending(entries)").
Default is by memoryDeep descending (or memorySelf if deep memory is skipped).

empty.description: If true, includes empty caches. Default is false.

inactive.description: If true, includes inactive/disabled caches. Default is false.

skipJavaStatics.description: If true, skips scanning Java static fields. Default is false.

skipMemory.description: If true, skips expensive memory measurement. Default is false.

skipMemoryDeep.description:
If true, skips deep memory traversal (Deep column). Only shallow memory (Self) is computed.
Faster than full measurement but less accurate. Default is false.

fullJavaClass.description:
If true, shows full Java class names (e.g., 'c3.platform.typesys.type.TypeMeta').
Default is false (shortened names like 'c.p.t.t.TypeMeta').

levels.description:
Number of nested levels to include in output. Default is 0 (no nesting).
When set, shows nested object paths within cache entries with their memory usage.
Each nested entry includes a 'path' field showing the traversal path (e.g., ".fields[]").
When grouping by 'path' via {@link Cache.Histo.Spec#group} and levels is unset, depth is unbounded.

Example with levels: 2:
```
Cache                        | Path       | Entries |    Self |    Deep
-----------------------------+------------+---------+---------+---------
TypeMeta#cache               |            |    1500 | 15.3 MB | 25.3 MB
TypeMeta#cache               | .fields    |    1500 |  3.2 MB |  8.2 MB
TypeMeta#cache               | .fields[]  |   12000 | 15.1 MB | 15.1 MB
TypeMeta#cache               | .methods   |    1500 |  2.4 MB |  6.4 MB
TypeMeta#cache               | .methods[] |    8000 | 12.3 MB | 12.3 MB
```

ttl.description:
Time-to-live in seconds for cached stats. Default is 60 seconds.
Stats collection is expensive (memory measurement, static field scanning), so results
are cached and reused within the TTL window.
Set to 0 to disable caching.

refresh.description: If true, forces refresh of cached stats regardless of TTL. Default is false.

title:
Specification for {@link Cache#histo}.

## Default Output (group: 'cache')

```
Cache                        | Entries |    Self |    Deep
-----------------------------+---------+---------+---------
TypeMeta#cache               |    1500 | 15.3 MB | 25.3 MB
MethodType#instances         |     800 |  8.0 MB | 12.1 MB
```

## Grouping Examples

### group: 'cache, kind'
Add kind column:
```
Cache                        | Kind                 | Entries |    Self |    Deep
-----------------------------+----------------------+---------+---------+---------
TypeMeta#cache               | Cache                |    1500 | 15.3 MB | 25.3 MB
MethodType#instances         | SimpleSingletonCache |     800 |  8.0 MB | 12.1 MB
```

### group: 'cache, javaClass'
Expand each cache by Java class (shows Self/Deep memory):
```
Cache                        | Java Class                   | Entries |    Self |    Deep
-----------------------------+------------------------------+---------+---------+---------
TypeMeta#cache               | c3.platform.typesys.TypeMeta |    1500 | 15.3 MB | 25.3 MB
TypeMeta#cache               | java.lang.String             |     100 |  0.5 MB |  0.5 MB
MethodType#instances         | c3.platform.typesys.Method   |     800 |  8.0 MB | 12.1 MB
```

### group: 'javaClass'
Aggregate by Java class across all caches:
```
Java Class                      | Entries |    Self |    Deep
--------------------------------+---------+---------+---------
c3.platform.typesys.TypeMeta    |    2300 | 20.5 MB | 38.5 MB
c3.platform.typesys.MethodType  |    1200 | 10.2 MB | 18.2 MB
java.lang.String                |    5000 |  2.1 MB |  2.1 MB
```

### group: 'app, javaClass'
Aggregate by app and Java class:
```
App              | Java Class                   | Entries |    Self |    Deep
-----------------+------------------------------+---------+---------+---------
prod-us-platform | c3.platform.typesys.TypeMeta |    2300 | 20.5 MB | 38.5 MB
prod-us-platform | java.lang.String             |    5000 |  2.1 MB |  2.1 MB
prod-us-myApp    | myApp.Customer               |     200 |  3.2 MB |  5.2 MB
```

### group: 'pkg'
Aggregate by package:
```
Pkg      | Entries |    Self |    Deep
---------+---------+---------+---------
platform |    3500 | 30.5 MB | 50.5 MB
myApp    |     200 |  3.2 MB |  5.2 MB
```
